text: {"reconstruction":4,"feasibility":3,"rationale":"The proposal gets the overall procedure and order right (arXiv advanced search by topic and year, open the top result, look up citations on Semantic Scholar, write a note in the exact format), but it leaves out the Subject {category} filter and parameter entirely, so an automation built from it would return the wrong search results; it also reads the first author from Semantic Scholar instead of arXiv and skips the new-tab and close-tab handling."}

data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall procedure and order right (arXiv advanced search by topic and year, open the top result, look up citations on Semantic Scholar, write a note in the exact format), but it leaves out the Subject {category} filter and parameter entirely, so an automation built from it would return the wrong search results; it also reads the first author from Semantic Scholar instead of arXiv and skips the new-tab and close-tab handling.
